description: 3x2 bilinear lattice whose control points are pulled asymmetrically off their rest grid, carried by a rotated joint. Control points are ABSOLUTE part-local positions, so each is lifted through Part.rect and then through the asset; a kernel that lifted x and y through the same dimension would pass on a square sheet and fail here. The corner points are left exactly on the rest grid, which pins the other half of the contract: an unmoved control point must land on exactly the same float as the rest grid puts it on, not merely near it.
